title: Elon Musk's X slapped with €120M fine by EU regulator for breaching content rules
summary: Elon Musk's social media company X was fined 120 million euros ($193.3 million Cdn) by EU tech regulators on Friday for breaching online content rules, the first sanction under landmark legislation that once again drew criticism from the U.S. government.
